title: Delete: a feature and everything only it uses
prompt: We're dropping order drafts. Remove the draft endpoint and everything only it uses.
done: the draft endpoint and the code only it used (CreateOrderDraftCommand, its handler and the draft DTO, unless used elsewhere) are gone

expect.text: The Services designer no longer has the draft operation, CreateOrderDraftCommand or the draft DTO, and nothing else was removed with them. Visuals on saved diagrams don't count: the agent is told to leave saved diagrams alone.
